storylines.title: Congressional Censorship Hearings Intensify
storylines.summary: House committees examine alleged government-Big Tech coordination. Major tech executives face tough questioning over content moderation practices.
storylines.whyItMatters: This investigation could reshape First Amendment protections and government-tech relationships for years to come.

keyPosts.text: The internal documents released today show systematic coordination between the FBI and Twitter to suppress legitimate political speech.
Tech executives unable to answer basic questions about algorithmic content decisions. More oversight necessary.
This hearing represents a historic moment for free speech in America. Congressional action is essential.

storylines.title: Border Crisis Reaches Record Levels
storylines.summary: Unauthorized crossings hit historic monthly high. Border patrol reports severe operational strain as processing capacity overwhelmed.
storylines.whyItMatters: This impacts federal budget allocation, local community resources, and international relations with neighboring countries.

keyPosts.text: CBP data shows 328,000 encounters in December alone. This is not just a statistical problem—families are suffering.
Cartels now openly operating border operations. American security is at stake.
Local communities demand federal action. City resources exhausted by influx.

storylines.title: Congress Debates Tech Giant Regulation
storylines.summary: Lawmakers propose sweeping antitrust measures. Bipartisan committee seeks to curb market dominance of Big Tech platforms.
storylines.whyItMatters: These regulations could reshape market competition, affect consumer privacy, and influence innovation across the tech sector.

keyPosts.text: Big Tech monopolies stifle innovation and free speech. Competition is the answer.
The proposed regulations would restore fair competition to the tech market.
Free speech and free markets go hand in hand.

storylines.title: School Choice Movement Gains Momentum
storylines.summary: Education bills advancing in multiple states. Parents demand alternatives to traditional public school models.
storylines.whyItMatters: This reflects growing tension between parental rights and institutional control, with implications for public education funding.

keyPosts.text: Parents across America are demanding control over their children's education. School choice is the solution.
Educational freedom matters. Choice benefits all students, not just the wealthy.

storylines.title: Energy Independence Policy Debate
storylines.summary: Administration backs domestic energy production. New proposals aim to reduce reliance on foreign oil markets.
storylines.whyItMatters: Energy policy decisions affect inflation, national security, and environmental considerations across the country.

keyPosts.text: Nuclear and natural gas are essential to American energy independence.
Fossil fuels have powered human progress. We need all energy sources.

storylines.title: Supreme Court Hears Free Speech Case
storylines.summary: Justices examine limits of government speech regulation. Case could reshape First Amendment protections.
storylines.whyItMatters: The Court's decision will set precedent for free speech protections affecting journalists, activists, and citizens nationwide.

keyPosts.text: Today's oral arguments suggest the Court takes the First Amendment seriously again.
This case will define free speech for a generation.

storylines.title: Traditional Media Trust Declines
storylines.summary: New surveys show historic low confidence in legacy news outlets. Viewers increasingly turn to independent sources.
storylines.whyItMatters: Declining trust in institutional media shapes how Americans access information and form opinions about national events.

keyPosts.text: Only 31% of Americans trust mainstream media. The public is voting with their eyeballs.
Independent journalism is the future. Trust is earned through transparency.
